input.prompt: At 4 PM, a shaded refresh station under sea grape trees at a private beach party: a low natural-teak console with rolled white cold towels, three plain unlabelled frosted-glass mist bottles with no labels at all, a round mirror on a stand, a ceramic bowl of ice; a guest smiling as she takes a cold towel from an attendant in white linen; dappled light, turquoise sea between the trunks.
